images.prompt: Vertical cinematic film still, photorealistic, ancient Babylon, warm gold and lapis-blue color grade, fine film grain. Keep the lower third darker and calm for text. No text, letters, numbers, symbols, carvings, inscriptions, logos or watermarks. No visible hands. No modern objects, no light bulbs, no lamps, no windows with glass. medium shot. An older Babylonian money lender with a grey beard, seen in profile, seated on a woven cushion beside a plain smooth undecorated cedar wood chest in a dim mud-brick room, calm and wise, warm golden torchlight.
